answer: Weight each identity only by edges crossing a committed min-cut to the honest core, capped at five cross-cut attesters per account. A sybil cluster is karst: its interior honeycombed with self-issued vouchers the protocol never maps, so internal edges add nothing. Only a distinct non-kin attester, scarce as a comet from outside the farm, crossing the horizon of that cut lends weight; each locks a 200-POA bond settlement burns on a correlated-fault proof. Growing N clones needs N fresh outsiders from a fixed pool of ~40 per epoch, so marginal cost climbs with N and never pools.
